introduction.zh: 愿意认同一项安排、感觉能做成一步、感到被关心，可以与受到施压、尝试被否定或被排除的体验分别理解。选定近四周一个普通领域，用24条原创题回看这六项。完整结果保留六项均分或资料不足与全部正文，不把它们合成总体动力、固定动机人物或职业结论；自主、胜任、联结的概念及满足与受阻区别会在下方说明。
introduction.en: Willingly endorsing an arrangement, feeling able to manage a step and experiencing care can be considered separately from pressure, dismissed attempts or exclusion. Choose one ordinary area over four weeks and reflect with 24 original items. Full results retain six means or insufficient-information states and all guides, without an overall motivation score, fixed persona or career verdict. The explanations distinguish the three needs and satisfaction from frustration.

instructions.zh: 先在心里选定近四周一个较常参与的普通领域，例如一门课程、一项兴趣活动或一类日常共同任务；整份题目沿用同一个领域，不必把领域名称输入网站。按每句话在该领域实际出现的频率，从1从不到5几乎总是选择；没有情境、资料不足或不愿回答都可选NA。24条原创题分别观察自主、胜任、联结的满足与受阻体验，各4条、至少3条有效才显示一位小数均分。六项分别保留；受阻题不反向，低满足不自动等于高受阻，不相减或合成总分，也不派固定动机类型。它不判断他人的真实意图、能力、健康、职业适配或你为何采取某个行动。
instructions.en: Choose in your mind one ordinary area you took part in over the past four weeks, such as a course, an interest activity or a kind of shared everyday task. Keep the same area throughout; do not enter its name on the website. Rate how often each statement occurred there from 1 Never to 5 Almost always. Choose NA for absent context, insufficient information or declining to answer. Twenty-four original items separately explore satisfaction and frustration experiences for autonomy, competence and relatedness. Each four-item part needs three ratings for a one-decimal mean. Keep all six parts separate: frustration is not reverse-scored, low satisfaction does not automatically mean high frustration, and there is no subtraction, total or fixed motivation type. The reflection determines no other person’s actual intention, ability, health, career fit or reason for your actions.

title.zh: 自主满足：认同自己的参与理由

headline.zh: 自主满足：认同自己的参与理由

summary.zh: 从共同任务里能否认同自己的理由，理解自主满足的高低、混合与资料不足；自主可以发生在合作中，不是独立、强势或固定动机型。
summary.en: Explore willingly endorsed participation, including cooperation, with higher, lower and mixed readings. Autonomy is no independence or fixed motivation type.

scoreReading.zh: 24条都选择后，六项分别计算。每项4条，1从不至5几乎总是；没有反向题，受阻体验不反向补成满足。NA是不适用、资料不足或不愿回答，排除而不补零、中性或其他项的分数。每项至少3条有效，才以计分和除有效条数取一位小数均分1—5；不足明确保留。六项不相加、不相减、不排最高人格或最重要需要，也没有总体动机分、健康指数、常模、百分位或科学阈值。相同均分保留，小数差异不证明显著或变化；中间值可能来自不同答案组合。最低条数只是本站完整度规则，不是已验证的心理测量标准。
scoreReading.en: After all 24 selections, calculate six parts separately. Each has four items rated 1 Never to 5 Almost always. There are no reverse items: frustration never reverses into satisfaction. Exclude NA for absent context, insufficient information or declining to answer, without filling zero, a midpoint or another part’s score. At least three ratings permit a one-decimal mean from 1 to 5, using scored sum divided by rated items; otherwise retain insufficient information. Do not add, subtract or rank the six means into a personality or most important need. There is no overall motivation score, health index, norm, percentile or scientific cutoff. Equal means stay equal; decimals establish no significance or change, and middle means can reflect different answers. The minimum is a website completeness convention rather than a validated psychometric standard.

title.zh: SDT自主满足结果：参与理由、例子与完整解释
title.en: SDT Autonomy Satisfaction: Full Result Guide

description.zh: 自主满足完整说明：区分自愿认同与独立做事，含高低、混合、资料不足、合作例子、五项对照与计分；不派固定动机型。
description.en: Read autonomy satisfaction as willing endorsement, with higher, lower and mixed examples, five comparisons and scoring. No independence or fixed-type verdict.

paragraphs.zh: 自主满足在这里指，你对参与方式或参与理由有自己的认同感。一个做法可以是别人先提出，也可以含共同规则；关键不是谁第一个说，而是你是否愿意认可自己正在做的事情。四条原创题关注选定领域近四周的这种体验，不统计你有多少独立决定，也不把顺从或反对本身当成自主。
paragraphs.en: Autonomy satisfaction here concerns feeling able to endorse your participation or its reasons. Someone else may have proposed the approach, and shared rules may still apply. The issue is not who spoke first but whether you willingly stand behind what you are doing. Four original items consider that experience in your chosen area over four weeks, rather than counting independent decisions or treating agreement and disagreement as automatic evidence of autonomy.

title.zh: 较高、较低、混合与资料不足
title.en: Higher, lower, mixed and insufficient readings

paragraphs.zh: 均分较高表示，这四类情境中较常报告认同自己的参与；较低表示较少报告，不能立即说你被控制。中间均分可能包含某些任务愿意、另一些任务拿不准，也可能每题都选有时。至少三条有效才显示个人均分；缺少情境保留资料不足。这里没有最理想位置，也不根据最高项给你命名为自主型。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates more frequent reported endorsement in these four selected situations; a lower mean indicates less, without establishing that someone controlled you. A middle mean may combine willingly chosen tasks with uncertain ones, or Sometimes responses throughout. At least three ratings are required for a personal mean. Missing context remains insufficient information. There is no ideal target or highest-score assignment of an autonomy-driven personality.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你和同伴一起安排一份兴趣活动材料，大家约好用同一格式。你原本偏好另一种版式，但理解统一后更容易互相查看，也愿意采用。这个合作决定仍可能包含自主满足。若你只是没有时间想清楚原因，就先记作尚不清楚；不能因为最后用了别人的格式，就直接判定缺少自主或需要退出合作。
paragraphs.en: Imagine preparing materials for a shared interest activity. The group agrees on one format. You originally preferred another, but understand why consistency helps everyone read it and willingly adopt the arrangement. That cooperative decision can include autonomy satisfaction. If you simply had no time to consider your reasons, record uncertainty. Using another person’s format does not by itself demonstrate lost autonomy or create a reason to withdraw from cooperation.

title.en: A possible way to express it

paragraphs.zh: 一句表达可以是：“这个格式不是我先提的，不过我认可统一之后更好交流，所以愿意这样做；这一小处我还想讨论。”它同时保留认同与不同意见。交流时可以确认哪些规则已有约定、哪些部分还有选择，不必证明每个细节都由自己决定。对方是否接受建议另看实际回应，问卷均分不能代替双方的沟通。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I did not propose this format, but I agree that consistency helps us communicate, so I am willing to use it; there is one detail I would still like to discuss.” Endorsement and disagreement can coexist. Clarify agreed requirements and remaining choices without needing to originate every detail. Whether a suggestion is accepted depends on the actual response, which a mean cannot replace or predict.

paragraphs.zh: 自主受阻另看受到施压、被迫认同等体验，不是把满足均分用6减掉。胜任满足看自己觉得能做成某一步，联结满足看被关心与接纳；三者可以各有不同。愿意参与但不会做，或与人亲近却不认可安排，都值得分别理解。胜任受阻另指尝试被否定后的受挫，联结受阻另指被排除的感受，也不能从本项均分补出。六项不排名、不相减，也不由自主满足推断内在兴趣、外在奖励或行动原因。
paragraphs.en: Autonomy frustration separately concerns pressure and compelled endorsement; it is not six minus the satisfaction mean. Competence satisfaction concerns feeling effective at a step, while relatedness satisfaction concerns care and acceptance. You may willingly participate while lacking confidence in a task, or feel close to people while questioning an arrangement. Competence frustration concerns felt dismissal of attempts; relatedness frustration concerns exclusion. Neither is supplied by this mean. Keep all six means separate, without ranking, subtraction or an inference about intrinsic interest, rewards or reasons for action.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，选择很多却不知道为何选择，不一定有较多认同；选择很少但真心理解共同要求，也可能有认同。必要职责、资源与关系中的权力差异要另看事实。这个均分不评独立、叛逆、领导力、智商、成熟、健康或工作适配，也不保证你的感受在别的领域或下个月相同。
paragraphs.en: Many available options do not guarantee endorsement if none feels meaningful to you. Few options can still allow willing acceptance of a shared requirement. Actual duties, resources and power differences require their own facts. The mean assesses no independence, defiance, leadership, IQ, maturity, health or career fit and cannot establish that your experience will be identical in another area or next month.

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：回想选定领域最近一次小安排，写下“实际要求”“我认可的理由”“还没想清楚的部分”，可以只回想，不必改变安排。若愿意交流，可以只问一个尚有选择的小细节。观察的目的在于分清理由与要求，不是追求更高均分、否定共同规则或证明自己必须单独做事。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, recall one small arrangement in your selected area. Separate the actual requirement, a reason you endorse and something still unclear. Recollection is enough; no change is required. If discussion is welcome, ask about one detail where choice remains. The purpose is clearer reasons and requirements, rather than a higher mean, rejection of shared rules or proof that you must work alone.

paragraphs.en: After all 24 selections, calculate six parts separately. Each has four items rated 1 Never to 5 Almost always. There are no reverse items: frustration never reverses into satisfaction. Exclude NA for absent context, insufficient information or declining to answer, without filling zero, a midpoint or another part’s score. At least three ratings permit a one-decimal mean from 1 to 5, using scored sum divided by rated items; otherwise retain insufficient information. Do not add, subtract or rank the six means into a personality or most important need. There is no overall motivation score, health index, norm, percentile or scientific cutoff. Equal means stay equal; decimals establish no significance or change, and middle means can reflect different answers. The minimum is a website completeness convention rather than a validated psychometric standard.

title.zh: 原创版本、文献与使用范围

paragraphs.zh: 本版是费马原创24题情境频率观察，以SDT三种基本心理需要为概念背景，分别整理满足与受阻体验；不是官方或标准量表、临床筛查或研究验证版本。没有采用BPNSFS、BPNSS、IMI、MWMS、WEIMS、GCOS等题本、键、常模、官方翻译或竞品题目、正文与算法。中英文题目、映射、例子与解释独立创作，尚无本站信度、效度或跨语言等价证据。文献提供概念背景，不验证本站题本、最低条数或分数解释；Martela与Ryan的开放论文依其CC BY 4.0许可提供背景，例子与说明为本站原创，该论文许可不扩为其他题本许可。均分不测需要的重要程度、真实能力、内外在动机调节、行动原因、他人意图、健康、产出、聘用或职业适配，也不把你分成五种固定动机人物。实际情境与职责仍需另看事实。
paragraphs.en: This original FermatMind 24-item contextual frequency reflection uses the three SDT needs as conceptual background while keeping satisfaction and frustration separate. It is no official, standard, clinical or research-validated instrument. No BPNSFS, BPNSS, IMI, MWMS, WEIMS, GCOS bank, key, norm, official translation or competitor items, body or algorithm is adopted. English and Chinese questions, mappings, examples and explanations are independently authored without local reliability, validity or established language equivalence. References provide background without validating this bank, minimum or interpretations. Martela and Ryan’s open article supplies background under CC BY 4.0; examples and explanations are original, and that article’s licence covers no other bank. Means assess no need importance, actual ability, motivational regulation, causes, others’ intentions, health, output, hiring or career fit, and assign no five fixed motivation personas. paragraphs.en: Imagine having only a few brief exchanges with one person in an interest activity. An omission or other facts may be involved, but the questionnaire cannot choose an explanation. One ordinary event need not become a verdict on the whole group or your identity, and the mean supplies no missing account.

paragraphs.en: Self-Determination Theory discusses autonomy, competence, relatedness and different forms of motivational regulation. If both are higher, consider different events or times rather than automatically declaring contradictory answers. If both are lower, neither experience may have occurred often, without establishing ideal balance. Keep all six parts and explicit missing information. All six full guides remain available together.
